reason: Chasing documents is genuinely my worst chore, and the WhatsApp link idea is clever, but you are asking me for 900 euro plus a monthly fee on the word of a part-time developer whose only client has not finished the pilot yet. With 5 to 15 files a year I can keep nagging people myself for free until someone I know in this business tells me it works.
objection: There is not one consultant in Romania I can call today who has used this and can tell me their files came in faster. The reference exists only 'after the 60-day pilot', and the refund guarantee depends on a measurement the seller sets up. And the add-on would not have saved my hour on the phone today, because that person never sent a request through a website in the first place.
would_change_my_mind: A phone call with the Bihor consultant after the pilot, with real before/after numbers from their own files, and ideally a second consultant I did not hear about from the founder.
